Alchemize.note: Generates a combat potion; Sozu prevents obtaining it.

Anointed.note: Tutors random rare cards from the draw pile, limited by hand space; upgraded version retains.

Automation.note: Every ten cards drawn yields energy; needs sustained draw, not just a large deck.

BeatDown.note: Autoplays random attacks from discard; basics dilute the pool and first-cycle discard may be empty.

Bolas.note: Returns to hand after being played on the previous turn; free repeat attack occupies a hand slot.

Calamity.note: Attacks generate random attacks that still cost energy; not free draw or a reason to collect filler.

Catastrophe.note: Autoplays two or three random playable draw-pile cards; discounts high-cost cards without guaranteeing a target.

DarkShackles.note: Temporary enemy Strength reduction; does not protect against non-attack effects.

Discovery.note: Chooses one of three random character cards, free this turn; discount random outcomes.

DramaticEntrance.note: Innate one-use AoE competes with engine setup in the opening hand.

Entropy.note: Transforms a hand card each turn in combat; replacement is random and not permanent removal.

Equilibrium.note: Retains the hand for one turn and blocks; helps line up energy and expensive cards.

EternalArmor.note: Persistent Plating with a three-energy setup cost; slow opening and repeated hits limit value.

Fasten.note: Improves Defend-tag cards only; not Dexterity or a buff to all block.

Finesse.note: Free self-replacement and small block; All for One can recover it.

Fisticuffs.note: Attack damage also becomes block; benefits from attack scaling, not Focus.

FlashOfSteel.note: Free attack with one draw; recycling is useful but it is not net draw by itself.

GoldAxe.note: Damage grows with cards played during this combat, not gold; needs a fast long-fight engine.

HandOfGreed.note: Gold requires a killing blow; future shops and early fights matter more than rarity.

HiddenGem.note: Enchants a random eligible draw-pile card with two or three replays for this combat; not a chosen best card.

Impatience.note: Draws only with no attacks in hand; attack-heavy decks cannot count it as reliable draw.

JackOfAllTrades.note: Random colorless generation, with no cost discount; one-use and uncertain output.

Jackpot.note: Three-cost attack generates three random zero-cost character cards; upgraded version upgrades them.

MasterOfStrategy.note: Zero-cost net draw that exhausts; useful setup without a lasting deck burden in combat.

Mayhem.note: Autoplays the top card each turn; timing, targets and X-cost cards can waste effects.

MindBlast.note: Opening attack scales with remaining draw pile; never rewards adding weak cards merely to increase size.

Nostalgia.note: Returns the first discarded Attack or Skill each turn to the draw-pile top; can repeat filler instead of a core card.

Omnislice.note: Free multi-target attack; direct damage scales with attacks rather than orbs.

Panache.note: Deals AoE after five cards played in a turn; needs sustainable card throughput.

PanicButton.note: Large immediate block followed by two turns of card-block suppression; Frost can cover the gap.

PrepTime.note: Grants Vigor each turn for an attack, not Strength or Focus.

Production.note: One-use energy; retained energy helps, but it does not draw a payoff.

Prolong.note: Next-turn block copies current block; cannot count the best-case block without setup.

Prowess.note: Strength and Dexterity help attacks and card block; neither improves orb damage.

Purity.note: Retained selective hand exhaustion removes curses, statuses or spent transition cards; costs a draw slot.

Rend.note: Damage depends on distinct enemy debuffs, not total stacks of one debuff.

Restlessness.note: Requires being the only card in hand before giving draw and energy; retention alone does not solve this condition.

RollingBoulder.note: Slow three-energy scaling AoE; requires time and defense rather than instant damage.

Salvo.note: Attack that retains the whole hand this turn; useful timing utility, not an orb engine.

Scrawl.note: Draws until the hand is full; upgraded version retains, it does not become zero-cost.

SecretTechnique.note: Tutors a Skill from the draw pile; reliable access to a useful engine component.

SecretWeapon.note: Tutors an Attack, especially All for One or a physical finisher.

SeekerStrike.note: Chooses among three random draw-pile cards; weaker selection than a full-pile tutor.

Shockwave.note: AoE Weak plus Vulnerable; Vulnerable improves attacks, not normal orb damage.

Splash.note: Chooses a random off-class attack and makes it free this turn; uncertain target quality.

Stratagem.note: Tutors after shuffling; needs repeated cycling, not simply a small starting deck.

TheBomb.note: Delayed AoE resolves after three turns; survival and kill timing matter.

TheGambit.note: Huge block but subsequent unblocked powered attack damage kills the player; never treat it as ordinary defense.

ThinkingAhead.note: Draw two then put one on top; filters and arranges a hand but only modest net draw.

ThrummingHatchet.note: Returns after being played on the previous turn; repeat damage still costs energy and hand space.

UltimateDefend.note: One-energy block with no draw, scaling or exhaustion; only explicit Defend synergies rescue it.

UltimateStrike.note: One-energy damage with no cycling or lasting scaling; low-priority transition even though it has a large number.

Volley.note: X repeated attacks convert energy and Strength into damage; Chemical X adds two hits.

Exterminate.note: Native event card: four hits to all enemies. Flat damage enchantments and Strength apply to each hit.

Whistle.note: Native Ancient card: 33/44 damage and stun, Exhaust itself; cannot remove other cards.
